From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Carter <jamie.carter@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 15:22:10 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + next steps (Atlas Health)

Hi Jamie — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our 30-minute discovery and suggested next steps: 

- Primary goals you shared: reduce inference latency for our triage model, cut per-token cost for nightly batch runs, and centralize model serving across environments (cloud + on-prem) for PHI workflows.
- Current constraints: HIPAA compliance, existing on-prem GPU pool (NVIDIA A40), and procurement window in Q1.
- Suggested Redwood approach: hosted API for rapid prototyping + a short Dedicated pilot to validate throughput/kg costs on your workloads.

Proposed next steps:
1) 2-week technical spike: run representative payloads against a sandbox (we take care of data handling guidance).
2) Pricing sketch & pilot worksheet attached (pilot-worksheet-ATL-4721.xlsx).
3) Sync with your infra lead for a 45-min technical session — proposed dates: Nov 9 or Nov 12.

Attachments: discovery-recap-AtlasHealth-1102.pdf (2 pages), pilot-worksheet-ATL-4721.xlsx (stub)

If this sounds right, can you confirm which next step you prefer and whom on your side should join the tech call? Happy to adjust.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Hi Jamie — wanted to follow up on the discovery recap I sent on Nov 2 and the pilot worksheet (attached). I know timing gets busy, so two quick asks: 

1) Is this something you see as a fit for Atlas Health right now? A yes/no is perfectly fine.
2) If yes — would you prefer: (A) a 45-min technical workshop w/ your infra & data team (I can send available times), or (B) a short sandbox spike (we'll run a small sample and share metrics)?

If you're not the right person for this, could you point me to who owns pilot/proof-of-concept decisions?

Attached: pilot-worksheet-ATL-4721.xlsx
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ATL-4721

Thanks for any quick guidance — if I don't hear back this week I'll assume timing is off and circle back in Q1.

Best,
